summary.text: John Kascenska is a Republican state representative from Essex-Caledonia who was first appointed to the Vermont House of Representatives in March 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, appearing on the ballot with both Republican and Democratic party labels.
He is a business owner with a doctorate in forestry.

paragraphs.text: John Kascenska earned a B.S. from Lyndon State College in 1982, an M.S. in education from Virginia Tech, and a Ph.D. in forestry from North Carolina State University.

His career experience includes owning Kingdom Adventures Mountain Guides, LLC, and working as an avalanche instructor with International Mountain Climbing School, an associate academic dean with Lyndon State College, and a lecturer at North Carolina State University.
Kascenska was appointed to the Vermont House on March 7, 2022, to replace Patrick Seymour in the Caledonia-4 district, and he held that seat from 2022 to 2023.
He assumed office in the Essex-Caledonia district on January 8, 2025, succeeding Terri Williams, and he advanced from both the Republican and Democratic primaries on August 11, 2026.
He served on the Commerce and Economic Development Committee in 2023-2024.
